name: September
title: Where to go on holiday in September
intro: September has more destinations at their best than any other month. The sea is at its warmest in the Mediterranean, the crowds have gone home, and prices fall.
seo_title: Where is hot in September? Late summer sun and where to go

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
September is the best month of the year for the Mediterranean. The sea is at its warmest, around 24 to 26°C, the days are still hot, mostly 26 to 31°C, and once the schools go back the crowds and prices fall fast. More of our guides are at their best in September than in any other month.

The hottest places are in the east: southern Turkey and Cyprus are still around 30 to 31°C. The western Mediterranean, Mallorca, Málaga and the Algarve, is a pleasant 27 to 29°C, and the big Italian and Spanish cities become comfortable for sightseeing again.

The temperatures below are average daytime highs for September, rounded. Flight times are typical direct flights from London. Everywhere at its best in September is listed above.

sections.heading: The ranking at a glance
sections.text:
The warmest beach places within about four and a half hours of the UK:

- **1. [Antalya](/destinations/antalya) and [Kaş](/destinations/kas):** around 31°C. About 4 hours.
- **2. [Paphos](/destinations/paphos):** around 30°C, with the warmest sea in Europe. About 4 hours 30 minutes.
- **3. [Rhodes](/destinations/rhodes) and [Málaga](/destinations/malaga):** around 29°C. 2 hours 45 minutes to 4 hours.
- **4. [Corfu](/destinations/corfu), [Kefalonia](/destinations/kefalonia), [Zakynthos](/destinations/zakynthos), [Mallorca](/destinations/mallorca), [Ibiza](/destinations/ibiza), [Malta](/destinations/malta) and [Bodrum](/destinations/bodrum):** around 28°C. 2 hours 15 minutes to 4 hours.
- **5. [Crete](/destinations/crete), [Menorca](/destinations/menorca), [Puglia](/destinations/puglia), the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve) and [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura):** around 27°C. 2 hours 30 minutes to 4 hours.
- **6. [Santorini](/destinations/santorini), [Dubrovnik](/destinations/dubrovnik), [Split](/destinations/split) and [Corsica](/destinations/corsica):** around 26°C. 2 hours 15 minutes to 4 hours.

sections.heading: Beach holidays after the crowds
sections.text:
If you can travel outside the school holidays, September gives you July's weather at prices closer to May's.

- **Greece:** [Crete](/destinations/crete), [Rhodes](/destinations/rhodes), [Corfu](/destinations/corfu), [Milos](/destinations/milos) and [Naxos](/destinations/naxos) are hot, with the sea at its warmest. The meltemi wind usually eases off.
- **Turkey and Cyprus:** the hottest choices, and good into October.
- **Spain and Portugal:** [Mallorca](/destinations/mallorca), [Menorca](/destinations/menorca), the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve) and [Cádiz](/destinations/cadiz) are warm and much calmer than in August.
- **Italy and Croatia:** [Puglia](/destinations/puglia), [Sicily](/destinations/syracuse), the [Amalfi Coast](/destinations/amalfi-coast) and [Dubrovnik](/destinations/dubrovnik) are at their best.

Late-season storms can bring a day or two of heavy rain, usually later in the month. Our [beach holidays](/destinations/beach-holidays) page has the full list.

sections.heading: City breaks as the heat fades
sections.text: September is one of the best months for southern European cities, which are too hot for comfort in July and August. [Rome](/destinations/rome) and [Florence](/destinations/florence) are around 27 to 28°C, [Madrid](/destinations/madrid) and [Lisbon](/destinations/lisbon) around 27°C, and [Barcelona](/destinations/barcelona) around 26°C. [Venice](/destinations/venice), [Budapest](/destinations/budapest), [Vienna](/destinations/vienna) and [Prague](/destinations/prague) are around 19 to 24°C, and the grape harvest starts in the [Douro Valley](/destinations/douro-valley). See our [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) page.

sections.heading: Long-haul in September
sections.text:
- **Indonesia:** [Bali](/destinations/bali) and [Lombok](/destinations/lombok) are still dry and around 31°C, but quieter than in summer.
- **Safari:** the [Maasai Mara](/destinations/maasai-mara), [Namibia](/destinations/namibia) and [Zanzibar](/destinations/zanzibar) are dry.
- **The USA:** [New York](/destinations/new-york), [Washington DC](/destinations/washington-dc) and [Boston](/destinations/boston) are warm without the summer humidity, and the [Utah national parks](/destinations/utah-national-parks) and [Grand Canyon](/destinations/grand-canyon) cool down.
- **Hawaii:** [Maui](/destinations/maui) is around 31°C and quieter than in the summer.

The Caribbean is at the peak of hurricane season, and much of Southeast Asia is wet.

sections.heading: How to choose
sections.text:
If you can avoid the school holidays, September is the month to book a Mediterranean beach holiday: pick Turkey or Cyprus for the most heat, Greece for the islands, and the Balearics or the Algarve for a short flight. For a city break, Rome, Florence and Madrid are pleasant again. And for long-haul, Bali and East Africa are at their best.

If you're choosing as a family or group and can't agree, put a few of these on a shortlist and let everyone vote with points. That's what somewhere🎉 is for, and our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday) explains how it works.

faqs.question: Where is still hot in September?
faqs.answer: The whole Mediterranean: Crete, Kefalonia, Naxos and Milos, Menorca, Corsica, Puglia, Malta and Gozo, Paphos, Croatia and the Turkish coast. The sea is warmer than in June.

faqs.question: Why is September such a good time to travel?
faqs.answer: Schools are back, so beaches and sights are quieter and prices drop, but the weather is still summery. It's ideal for couples, friends, families with children under school age, and anyone who can take time off in term time.

faqs.question: What's good further away in September?
faqs.answer: New York, Boston and Washington, D.C. are warm without the summer humidity. Canada's autumn colours start in Banff and Quebec. Bali, Lombok and Zanzibar are still dry, and the Maasai Mara's migration continues.

faqs.question: Where is the hottest place in Europe in September?
faqs.answer: Southern Turkey and Cyprus, around 30 to 31°C. Rhodes and Málaga are close behind at around 29°C.

faqs.question: Is the sea warm in September?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Mediterranean is at its warmest in late August and September, around 24 to 26°C, and warmest of all in the east, around Cyprus and Turkey.

faqs.question: Is September cheaper than August?
faqs.answer: Usually much cheaper, once the schools go back in the first week of September. The weather is almost the same, and the resorts are far quieter.
